title: Scriptura Canonical Reference
description: A canonical Bible reference. Normative source: BKB-DATA-001 section 3.

book.description: Stable book key from the book registry. Never a display name.

canon_profile.description: The canon profile against which this reference is valid.

chapter.description: Chapter number, or null for a whole-book reference.

verse_start.description: First verse, or null for a chapter-level reference.

verse_end.description: Last verse. Null for a single verse; must be >= verse_start when present.

display.description: Derived human-readable form. Derived from the reference, never parsed without validation.
